title: WhatsAppVsChatLKBenchmarkDataset
description: Evidence-based comparative benchmark dataset between WhatsApp and ChatLK (inclusive-eyes-chatlk)

metadata.auditor: Antigravity App Comparison & Analysis Intelligence Engine

apps.name: ChatLK
apps.architecture: Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects WebSockets + D1 SQLite + R2 + Workers AI

whatsapp.evidence: Broadest messaging feature set, 1024-member groups, status, communities, payments, channels

chatlk.evidence: src/components/ChatRoom.tsx: Pinning, status updates, reactions, 50-member groups, AI smart replies, lacking E2EE and communities

whatsapp.evidence: Signal Protocol End-to-End Encryption (Zero-Knowledge) on all messages, calls, and status

chatlk.evidence: src/lib/crypto.js: PBKDF2-SHA256 (100k iter), strict CSP in src/index.js:8-15, but messages stored server-side in Cloudflare D1

dimensions.name_si: ගෘහ නිර්මාණ ශිල්පය සහ කේත තත්ත්වය

whatsapp.evidence: Industry-proven Erlang concurrency, Noise protocol, distributed multi-datacenter infrastructure

chatlk.evidence: src/do/chat-room.js: Clean Durable Objects WebSockets with Hibernation API, Hono REST router, zero-dependency Node compatibility

whatsapp.evidence: Opus 6-12kbps audio compression, native OS threading, battery-optimized FCM background sync

chatlk.evidence: Cold start 420ms (PWA cache), Ultra-low WebSocket latency via Colombo Edge node (<60ms), but WebRTC audio uses standard bitrate

whatsapp.evidence: Familiar world-standard interface, touch-friendly, dark/light theme, system font integration

chatlk.evidence: Familiar green bubble theme, Status, Chats, Calls navigation tabs, responsive PWA layout, ARIA labels in components

whatsapp.evidence: Massive global engineering org, continuous automated CI/CD release cycles

chatlk.evidence: Wrangler 4.x deployment, npm test suite, idempotent migrations 0001-0019 in migrations/ directory

whatsapp.evidence: Static Sinhala UI translation exists, but lacks real-time translation and Sri Lanka specific workflow customizations

chatlk.evidence: src/routes/ai.js:37: Built-in Workers AI real-time translation between Sinhala (si), Tamil (ta), and English (en)

whatsapp.verdict_si: සමස්ත ගෝලීය ආරක්ෂක සහ විශේෂාංග ප්‍රමුඛයා (Global Security & Scale Leader)

chatlk.verdict_si: විශිෂ්ට ශ්‍රී ලාංකික කලාපීය සහ AI සන්නිවේදන විසඳුම (Regional AI & Edge Champion)

feature_matrix.evidence: ChatLK uses Durable Objects WebSocket Hibernation API (src/do/chat-room.js:55)
WhatsApp has Signal Protocol E2EE; ChatLK messages are stored in D1 database
ChatLK provides WebRTC call overlay entry points (src/components/Calls.tsx)
